name: notifyd Self-Hosted Notifications
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted notification server with email, SMS, push and in-app inbox; no software license fee, expiry or published software usage quota. Runs with PostgreSQL via Docker or standalone binary.
watch_out: Hosting and PostgreSQL are not included. External delivery providers (SMTP, Resend, Twilio, Telnyx, push services) may charge or impose their own limits; configure API keys, secrets and provider accounts. No free hosted notifications are included.
